nphi.title: IANPHI Europe Regional Network
nphi.actor: IANPHI Europe Regional Network (chair: Public Health Center of Ukraine)
nphi.with: Public Health Center of the MoH of Ukraine (chair); Austrian National Public Health Institute GÖG (vice chair); 42 member NPHIs
nphi.summary: Network of 42 European NPHIs holding annual meetings (supported by IANPHI since 2006) on health security, climate, data and the future role of NPHIs.

nphi.title: 2025 IANPHI Europe Regional Network Meeting (Oslo)
nphi.with: GÖG; PHC Ukraine; RIVM; ISS; IPH Serbia; IHMT; Santé publique France; INSPQ; Public Health Wales; ECDC; WHO Europe; WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; DG HERA
nphi.summary: FHI hosted European NPHIs on their role in health security preparedness, medical countermeasures and resilience amid funding shifts and misinformation.

nphi.title: QUANTUM – quality and utility labels for health data (EHDS)
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Instituto Aragonés de Ciencias de la Salud (coordinator); 35 partner organisations
nphi.summary: Project developing quality and utility labels for health data for the European Health Data Space, with 35 organisations across 14 countries including Norway.

nphi.title: UNITED4Surveillance – Union and National Capacity Building for Integrated Surveillance
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (WP lead); Robert Koch Institute; Statens Serum Institut; THL; AGES; NVSC Lithuania; SZÚ Czechia; ECDC; Ukraine (observer country)
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action of ~40 public health institutes from 24 countries, coordinated by RIVM, to strengthen integrated infectious disease surveillance (outbreak detection, hospital surveillance, One Health); Norway's NIPH co-leads work…

nphi.title: 2023 IANPHI Europe Annual Meeting (Lisbon)
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Dr. Ricardo Jorge (INSA)
nphi.with: FHI; IPH Montenegro; THL; NIJZ Slovenia; RIVM; Public Health Wales; Sciensano; TAI Estonia; GÖG; EODY; PHC Ukraine; BZgA; UKHSA; Santé publique France; ECDC; WHO Europe; EuroHealthNet
nphi.summary: INSA hosted European NPHIs to discuss new challenges for the next decade, including climate and environment, health security and health data.

nphi.title: CLIMOS – Climate monitoring and decision support for sand fly-borne diseases
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); Ministry of Health of Türkiye; Ministry of Health of Israel; Italian Ministry of Health; Hacettepe and Ege universities; University of Haifa; Institute for Medical Research Belgrade; Charles University; Wageningen University; INSERM; UFZ; KIT
nphi.summary: Horizon Europe climate-and-health project building an early-warning and decision-support framework for sand fly-borne diseases (e.g. leishmaniasis) under climate change across the Mediterranean, with Italy's ISS and Turkish, Israeli and…

nphi.title: BE READY – European Research Partnership for pandemic preparedness (CSA)
nphi.actor: AGES – Austrian Agency for Health and Food Safety
nphi.with: ANRS-MIE; Statens Serum Institut; NIPH Norway; NIZP-PZH; Laboratoire national de santé; ISS; RIVM; UKRI
nphi.summary: Coordination and support action preparing a European pandemic-preparedness research partnership with a One Health approach; partners include Norway and the UK.

nphi.title: EAVI – European-African Vaccine Initiative against chikungunya in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.with: Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII); Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI, trial sponsor); Ifakara Health Institute (scientific lead); Valneva Austria; EPFL; Karolinska Institutet
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 partnership running a phase IIIb chikungunya vaccine trial in Kenya and Tanzania and preparing master protocols for future NTD vaccine trials; Spain's ISCIII and KEMRI participate.

nphi.title: TEHDAS2 – Towards the European Health Data Space
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.summary: Second Joint Action on the European Health Data Space across 29 countries including Norway and Iceland; NIJZ contributes to two work packages.

nphi.title: EU-WISH – EU Wastewater Integrated Surveillance for Public Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health; Statens Serum Institut (supporting organisation); partners from 26 countries
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action with partners in 26 countries (incl. non-EU Norway and Ukraine) to strengthen wastewater-based surveillance of biological and chemical agents.

nphi.title: Lancet Countdown Europe 2026 report presentation with national success stories
nphi.with: Santé publique France; Austrian Climate and Health Competence Centre; Heidelberg University; ISGlobal; European Environment Agency; WHO Europe
nphi.summary: Event in Heidelberg (22 April 2026) presenting the third Europe report of the Lancet Countdown, with RKI, Santé publique France and Austria's Climate and Health Competence Centre as national health-agency examples.

nphi.title: IANPHI 2025 annual meeting session on climate change and disease
nphi.with: Fiocruz; Santé publique France; Gesundheit Österreich (GÖG); IEDCR Bangladesh; Public Health Agency of Sweden
nphi.summary: Session where Fiocruz, Santé publique France (chair of the IANPHI Climate Thematic Committee), Austria's GÖG and Bangladesh's IEDCR shared COP29/30, heat-health monitoring and flood experiences.

nphi.title: 2024 IANPHI Europe Regional Network Meeting (Budva)
nphi.actor: Institute of Public Health of Montenegro (IJZCG)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (network chair); Public Health Center of Ukraine (vice chair); ECDC; GÖG; Public Health Scotland; ASPHER; HERA; WHO Europe
nphi.summary: Montenegro's IPH hosted European NPHIs and ECDC to discuss climate and health, research preparedness for emergencies, conflict-related AMR and regional collaboration.

nphi.title: APARET – African Programme for Advanced Research Epidemiology Training (EU FP7)
nphi.actor: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine
nphi.with: AFENET; Makerere University; University of Ghana; KNUST; Université Joseph Ki-Zerbo; University of Zimbabwe; MUHAS; Ahmadu Bello University; Swiss TPH; WHO; National Foundation for the CDC
nphi.summary: EU-funded programme (2011-2014) supporting FETP graduates in Africa to become independent researchers through mentoring, workshops and small grants.
